top_choice_rationale: Circuit QED established controlled light–matter interaction with superconducting artificial atoms as a mature, reproducible platform for quantum optics. The case rests on that foundational physics, independent of later quantum-computing applications.
recusal_note: My research is in superconducting circuits and quantum optics; I lead WACQT and have close professional ties to Chalmers colleagues in this field. These connections may require recusal on P002 under applicable committee rules.
